final_synthesis_label: Triadic Collaborative Support Plan with Implementation Caveats
final_synthesis_description: All three stakeholders accepted the triadic framework distributing responsibility across Alex, Margaret, and community systems, though both Alex and Margaret noted the synthesis is more coherent in theory than in practice, flagging real-world friction in initiating the honest conversation and accessing formal support systems.
remaining_disagreements: Alex is uncertain whether the synthesis adequately accounts for the emotional and logistical cost of implementation as the primary decision-maker
Margaret values being recognized as an active agent but questions whether formal support systems are realistically accessible in her context
The synthesis does not fully resolve who bears responsibility if community infrastructure proves inadequate or unavailable
